questions.prompt: How many total individual plastic bottle caps are recycled by all municipal recycling plants in Sweden in a single year?
reasoning: Sweden has a population of about 10 million people.
Each person consumes roughly 120 bottled beverages annually.
Multiplying 10 million people by 120 bottles gives 1.2 billion bottle caps recycled.

questions.prompt: How many total individual stitches are sewn into all professional-grade baseballs manufactured globally in a single year?
reasoning: There are approximately 3.6 million professional-grade baseballs manufactured worldwide each year.
Each standard baseball features exactly 108 raised stitches.
Multiplying 3.6 million baseballs by 108 stitches yields 388.8 million total stitches.

questions.prompt: How many total hours do all domestic pet rabbits kept in households across France spend eating fresh vegetables collectively in a single day?
reasoning: France has about 2.5 million pet rabbits in households.
An average pet rabbit spends roughly 1 hour per day chewing and eating vegetables and hay.
Multiplying 2.5 million rabbits by 1 hour gives 2.5 million total hours.
